meeting.note: Every Tuesday, year-round. Across from Pensacola State College.

calendar.note: The troop publishes its own feed at /calendar.ics, built from data/ by scripts/build_ics.py. The subscribe links on calendar.html are derived from site.url — there is nothing to paste and no account to connect. Set icsHref, downloadHref, subscribeHref or embedHref here only to override one.

admin.note: The URL of the troop's Cloudflare Worker, which holds the GitHub token and does the committing. Until this is filled in, the editor stages changes but cannot publish.

banner.text: Fall recruitment night is Tuesday 25 August — bring a friend who has never camped.
